items.exampleEn: The price of this bag is too high.
items.exampleZh: 這個包包的價格太高了。

items.exampleEn: He is poor, but he is happy.
I bought a birthday card for my mom.
items.exampleZh: 我買了一張生日卡片給我媽媽。

items.exampleEn: The owner of this cafe is my friend.
items.exampleZh: 這家咖啡店的老闆是我朋友。

items.sentenceEn: I want to order two coffees.

items.audioEn: The store owner is nice. He gives me free candy.
items.audioZh: 這家店的老闆人很好，他送我免費的糖果。

items.sentenceEn: This card is for my teacher.
items.sentenceZh: 這張卡片是給我老師的。

items.stemEn: The ____ of these shoes is fifty dollars.
items.stemZh: 這雙鞋的價格是五十美元。

items.stemEn: Mr. Lin has a small shop. He is the ____.
items.stemZh: 林先生有一家小店，他是老闆。

items.passageEn: Mr. Chen is the owner of a small store. He sells cards, pens, and toys. His prices are not high, so many children come to his store. Some families in the town are poor, so he often gives them free items. Everyone likes him.
items.passageZh: 陳先生是一家小店的老闆，他賣卡片、筆和玩具。他的價格不高，所以很多小孩會來他的店。鎮上有些家庭很窮，所以他常常送他們免費的東西。大家都很喜歡他。

questions.questionZh: 陳先生常常送貧窮的家庭什麼？

items.promptZh: 這家店的老闆是我叔叔。
referenceEn: The owner of this store is my uncle.
The store owner is my uncle.
rubricZh: 「這家店的老闆」可寫 the owner of this store、the store owner、the owner of this shop 等

referenceEn: The price is on the back.
The price is written on the back.
rubricZh: 「在背面」可寫，例如 on the back、is written on the back 等
